faults.name: Door gasket worn, door misaligned or blocked from closing
Overloading, blocked vents or warm contents
Hot surroundings or no clearance for ventilation
Auto-defrost failure (heater, thermal fuse, timer, defrost sensor)
Excess frost in a manual-defrost unit (needs defrosting)
Blocked defrost drain or cracked drain pan
External power supply (plug, socket, MCB/RCCB, stabiliser, outage)
Start relay, overload relay or capacitor
Temperature-control electronics (thermostat, thermistor, damper, control boards) or appliance wiring
